items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 define Rec=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, Hist_n=Rec^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), H_next=H_(n+1), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Let readTime(live(T,z))=T and readTime(stopped)=0; a(h)=readTime(h_n), and U(w)=readTime(H_next(w)_(n+1)). Thus U reads the actual next record, rather than being defined as a shifted waiting time. Set W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Set ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z) exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. The relative append A_rel(h,s) preserves every old coordinate and appends live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and stopped when h_n=stopped. Define A_abs(h,u)=A_rel(h,u−a(h)) and L_abs(h,u)=(A_abs(h,u),u). The raw harmonic flow at negative real time, clipped cumulative increment and stopped time0 are auxiliary totalizations. H_n,H_next,a,U,A_abs,L_abs are Borel; for every abstract (h,u) and every 0≤j≤n, A_abs(h,u)_j=h_j. For any fixed Borel b:Hist_n→[0,∞), finite at every history but not required uniformly bounded, put d(h)=max(b(h)−a(h),0) and D_b(h,u)=1_{a(h)<u<b(h)}ρ(h_n,u−a(h)). Define B_rel={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))} and B={w:H_n(w)_n and H_next(w)_(n+1) are live, a(H_n(w))<U(w)<b(H_n(w))}. Let X(w)=(H_n(w),U(w)), Y(w)=(H_next(w),U(w)), and ν_b=D_b(μ_n⊗du), where du is real Lebesgue measure. D_b is jointly Borel and ∫_ℝD_b(h,u)du≤1 for EVERY abstract history h. B,X,Y are Borel and B_rel=B pointwise. For every w∈B, U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n) and H_next(w)=A_abs(X(w)). The exact restricted laws are X_*(P|B)=ν_b, Y_*(P|B)=(L_abs)_*ν_b and (H_next)_*(P|B)=(A_abs)_*ν_b, with ν_b(univ)≤1. For every jointly Borel G:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du is Borel and, for every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}G(X(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du is Borel and ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability of F,G, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, finite wait, no-atom, probability or density provider is assumed. This includes n=0, rank zero, zero hazard, stopped records, live infinite waits, b(h)≤a(h), null A and unrealizable histories; missing mass is not normalized. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one absolute-coordinate ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), not a standalone printed theorem. Finite ordered iteration, terminal survival/full path/count assembly, full(A.7), physical-time restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation/errors/unbounded query costs/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, including rank zero.
Exactly six source analytic hypotheses: α>0, α≤β, V∈C², α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v, η>0 and βη≤1; α,β≥0.
y,xRef,z₀ and deterministic n are universally quantified; the exponential product, clipped thresholds, stopped recursion and observations are literal definitions.
b is any fixed Borel finite-valued history function, possibly globally unbounded. F and G are arbitrary jointly Borel extended nonnegative tests; A is any Borel old-history event.

Joint measurability, actual clock/append identities, fiber mass and all distribution/integration statements are conclusions. No independence, normalization, no-atom or finite-wait premise is supplied.

formulae.label: Absolute-time law 3
formulae.tex: B=B_{\rm rel},\quad w\in B\Longrightarrow U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t_n(w),\quad H_{n+1}(w)=A_{\rm abs}(H_n(w),U(w)).

Fixed y,xRef,z0 and deterministic event depth n; arbitrary fixed Borel finite-valued absolute horizon b may be unbounded across histories. U reads the actual next record. Strict live event a(Hn)<U<b(Hn) equals the positive relative-cap event. Borel absolute density, every-history fiber mass<=1, guarded actual clock/whole-history append, exact actual restricted joint/marginal laws and all joint ENNReal tests on every old-history event (including null ones) are derived internally. Existing actual-input a.s. nonaccumulation78 and half-open coverage79 are retained and not reproved. Only one coordinate edge within S87-I5/G86-11 is targeted.
